name: Sakura
source: Sakura is a blonde “gangster” who is strangely looking for Doujinshi on New Year’s Eve for her brother who is hospitalized. Despite seemingly the main protagonist, she shares the same amount of spotlight as the other characters. Being a gangster, Sakura has two comrades named “Miso” and “Buu”, who share most of the comical spotlight.
